en.title: Access application links through ModuleInfo
en.summary: "Read help, EULA, privacy statement, and locale-aware context-sensitive help links from an app manifest at runtime through additional ModuleInfo properties. Business value: Extensions can surface application-specific help, legal, and privacy resources dynamically instead of duplicating links in code. Context-sensitive help can also respect the current user's locale, improving support experiences for multilingual deployments."
